answer_key._how: Judgment labels only, per profile. Every activity not listed for a profile is irrelevant to it. breaks = hard-constraint ids the activity text shows it breaks; schedule fit is NOT stored, code computes it from available_windows minus the runtime update's adds_busy (update = runtime update id injected in this task). starting_calendar = the activities already on the student's calendar before the task (earlier agent plans; also rows in events): 8001 fits before the update and overlaps the update's busy time, so it must be removed (planned_event_removed); 8013 doesn't clash and stays. Correct answer = ONE replacement event that is relevant, not a dislike, breaks nothing, and fits the schedule after the update; reference_solution lists the valid replacements (either one is correct). P4 allows max 2 activities/week (H3): the kept 8013 + one replacement = 2, so adding both replacements (or any two) breaks the cap (hard_constraints counts the kept calendar activities too).
